I'm **Hazel (she/they)**, a Texas-based full-stack developer in **C#, .NET and Angular**. I make small, local-first apps that each do one job, and AI tooling I can prove works. A good tool should be reliable, approachable and a little bit cozy.&nbsp;♡

<p align="center">˚ ༘ ♡ ⋆｡˚ ✿ ˚ ༘ ♡ ⋆｡˚</p>

### 🧸 apps i've shipped ‧₊˚

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

💾 **[XIV Vault](https://hazeliscoding.github.io/xiv-vault/)**<br>
Moves your Dalamud setup to a new PC: plugin settings, HUD, hotbars, keybinds and macros. Every backup is hash-checked, and every restore takes a safety backup first.

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

💰 **[Gil Sweep](https://hazeliscoding.github.io/gil-sweep/)**<br>
Answers "what should I farm for gil right now?" from market demand, competition, price trends and node timers on your world.

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🍡 **[Prompuff](https://hazeliscoding.github.io/prompuff/)**<br>
Keeps the prompts that worked, with tags, versions and `{{variables}}`, and hands them to your agents over MCP. No account, no cloud.

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🧹 **[Sweepling](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/sweepling)**<br>
Finds the dev servers and watchers your Claude Code sessions left running on Windows, and closes them only after you say so.

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🔀 **[PR Sweep](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/pr-sweep)**<br>
Shows where your team's pull requests are stuck this sprint, across a whole GitHub org, with no labels to maintain.

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🗺️ **[ConAtlas TX](https://conatlas-tx.vercel.app)**<br>
Puts every anime con in Texas on one calm page, with dates checked against each organizer's own site.

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🐾 **[Staypaw](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/staypaw)**<br>
Puts your keyboard focus back when another app steals it, and holds the keys you press meanwhile so the stealer never gets them. Nothing injected, no telemetry.

</td>
</tr>
</table>

> Apparently, my response to a minor inconvenience is to build an entire app about it.

### 🤖 ai engineering, proven ‧₊˚

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🎮 **[sdl3-porter](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/sdl3-porter)**<br>
Ports SDL2 code to SDL3 and catches the bugs that still compile. Each of its 17 traps is proven by a fixture in CI, and Haiku 4.5 went from **0.39 to 0.92** with it. [How I proved it](https://www.hazeliscoding.dev/blog/every-trap-is-proven)

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

🧪 **[Axiomarium](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/axiomarium)**<br>
Tests your AI coding setup like software: agents, skills, hooks and evals, plus `axm`, a CLI that checks them.

</td>
</tr>
</table>

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

### 🌷 building now ‧₊˚

- 🐰 **[Shybun](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/shybun)** mutes your mic and camera in every Windows app with one key. Its badge says you're muted only when Windows confirms it.
- 🧾 **[Tattlehop](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/tattlehop)** keeps a receipt of what your coding agents changed on your PC outside the repo, and undoes it once you say so. Nothing leaves your PC.
- 🏷️ **[Carmine Workbench](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/carmine-workbench)** swaps the tokens, cookies and API keys in curl commands, headers and logs for labels before you share them, so the debugging detail stays. Nothing you paste leaves your PC.
- 🪡 **[Mendmoth](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/mendmoth)** shows your sticker on every background, fills the see-through gaps that dark mode gives away, and exports it for every place you post. Nothing leaves your browser.
- 💥 **[Oopsling](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/oopsling)** turns a crash in your .NET app into a GitHub issue the user files from their own browser. The app itself sends nothing.
- 🎨 **[Wippup](https://github.com/hazeliscoding/wippup)** turns the Krita or Procreate file you already saved into a vertical reel of the piece coming together, for the times you didn't record. Nothing leaves your browser.

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">
